model: 3-D steady conduction (7-point Laplacian, tree/straight masks identical to dimension_sensitivity.json) coupled to a 1-D coolant march; one wall temperature per channel column; no velocity field is solved, so this is NOT CFD

physical_anchor.note: K_SCALE = q_cell/(k*h) because the source sits on ONE layer of the block. The 3-D block is 27x27x9 mm against the 2-D slab's 45x45x5 mm, so its R_th is NOT the section 4.5 value and the two must not be swapped.

energy_accounting.summation_domain: interior cells only, y and x in 1..grid-2. field.solve_heat_3d closes the four sides with mirror copies (Tn[:,0,:]=Tn[:,1,:] etc.), so rows and columns 0 and grid-1 are ghosts that carry no equation and duplicate a real cell; a channel<->solid face is counted only when the SOLID side is interior. Including the ghosts double-counted faces and broke the identity at 7.2e-2; excluding them closes it to 1.6e-05 over the whole sweep.
energy_accounting.D: leak on solid-solid faces of the top skin: field.solve_heat_3d couples z=9 to z=8 with weight 2 in the skin's equation and weight 1 in the neighbour's, so those faces do not cancel
energy_accounting.bias: D sits only on solid-solid faces; the peak is above the source, i.e. under a channel cell, so the peak is not the quantity D biases -- the coolant load is
energy_accounting.treatment: the march renormalises the absorbed distribution to P_inj (renormalise=True), so tree and straight are compared at equal delivered power; the raw run is reported in closure_sensitivity

verdict: 3-D conduction with a 1-D coolant march, 30 x 30 x 10 cells, equal occupancy (150 = 150) and equal source coverage (25/25 both). At the calibration flow 0.728 L/min (Pi = 379.9, coolant rise 12.06 C for 253 W) the peak difference at Bi=1 is +1.8128 C on a +12.06 C total coolant rise; over Bi in {0, 1, inf} and Pi in {38, 379.9, 3799} the sign is NOT stable and the extremes are -0.0822 / +18.9904 C. Rebuilding at grid 40 at fixed flow moves the difference by at most 1.0e+00 C at the calibration flow (+1.81 -> +2.84 C at Bi=1) and by 1.1e+01 C at the lowest flow. The exact identity P_inj = P_chan + P_base + D, summed over interior cells only (the solver closes the lateral boundaries with mirror copies), closes to 1.6e-05 relative on every run; the heat D escaping through the nominally adiabatic top skin is 0.689% of P_inj for the tree mask and 5.78% for the straight mask, so the march is run at equal DELIVERED power (gain reported per case) and the raw run is reported alongside, where the same difference is +1.8958 C.
